_comment: Lab limits for ux-lab.mjs. `absolute` values are targets: exceeding one is reported but never fails a run. `regression` tolerances compare against the newest committed baseline in _architecture/perf-baselines/ and fail `--strict` (CI). Lab numbers use Lighthouse's default mobile throttling on a brotli-compressed static preview, so compare this repo with itself, not with field data. Tighten the tolerances once several baselines show the real run-to-run noise.
